newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures closed lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures closed lower on profit-taking.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude closed lower on Tuesday amid profit-taking after Monday's sharp rise, brokers said.
But they said sentiment remained well supported in a fundamentally-driven market.
January settled at $23.48 per barrel, down 14 cents from London's IPE close of $23.62, after recording 109 lots.
February closed at $22.90, down 15 cents after recording 114 lots.
NYMEX January crude on the after-hours ACCESS system last traded at $24.60, 20 cents below its previous official close.
